title: Find Company Websites From a List of Names With LinkFinder AI
coverSub: From a list of company names to their official websites
cover: In this video we are going to see how to find company websites from a list of names using LinkFinder AI.
payoff: Here is what you end up with. Ten company names went in, and every one came back with its official website, ready to export. Now let's see how.
outro: That's the whole flow: a list of company names in, their websites out. Click the first link in the description to create your free account and run your own list. Next, watch how to find the people who work at each of these companies.
outroHeadline: Run your own list of companies
outroSub: Free account, credits included. First link in the description.

mocks._source: Real results of find_company_website (LinkFinder AI API), 12 Nov 2026

click.text: I just need one lookup for now

steps.narration: Click Company website. It finds a company's official website from its name, for one credit per company.
Fill in the company name. We type Microsoft.
In about two seconds you get microsoft.com, the company's official domain.
Now the real use: a whole list. Click Upload CSV, bulk.
Click Select File and pick your CSV. One column of company names is enough. Ours has ten, from Microsoft and Salesforce to Airbnb.
LinkFinder AI finds the company name column and shows you the rows before anything runs.
Each row fills in as it runs: salesforce dot com, tesla dot com, hubspot dot com.
Ten companies in, ten websites out, every one marked Found.
Click Export to download the list as a CSV, ready for your CRM or your next enrichment.
